noProgram: No program is set up yet.
projectedNote: Projected sessions assume every session between now and then gets completed — the rotation follows what you complete, not the date, so a missed day shifts everything after it.
projectedNotePinned: Projected sessions assume every session between now and then gets completed — each weekday's session is fixed, so a missed day never changes what a later day offers.
rotationLine: {{rotationList}} alternate in the order you complete them.

dayDetail.nothingLogged: Nothing was logged this day — the session shifted forward, nothing was lost.
dayDetail.nothingLoggedPinned: Nothing was logged this day — nothing was lost. This weekday still offers the same session next time.
dayDetail.notPartOfPhase: This date isn't part of this phase.

import.replaceWarning: Your existing program is replaced. The imported file becomes the plan; logged workouts are untouched.
import.duplicateSessionId: Two sessions share the id "{{sessionId}}" — session ids must be unique.
import.unknownRotationSession: Rotation references session id "{{rotationId}}", which no session in this file defines.
import.weekdaySessionNotTrainingDay: $t({{weekdayKey}}) isn't a training day — weekdaySessions can only pin a session to a training weekday.
import.unknownWeekdaySession: weekdaySessions references session id "{{sessionId}}", which no session in this file defines.
import.exerciseNotInLibrary: Exercise id "{{exerciseId}}" in session "{{sessionId}}" doesn't exist in the Library.
import.ambiguousPrescriptionModel: Exercise "{{exerciseId}}" in session "{{sessionId}}" has both a Range and a setPlan — a prescription must be one or the other, never both.
import.ladderRequiresRepsMode: Exercise "{{exerciseId}}" in session "{{sessionId}}" has a setPlan but its mode isn't "reps" — ladders are reps-only.
import.substitutionListsSelf: Exercise "{{exerciseId}}" in session "{{sessionId}}" lists itself as a substitution.
import.duplicateSubstitution: Exercise "{{exerciseId}}" in session "{{sessionId}}" lists substitution "{{substitutionId}}" twice.
import.substitutionNotInLibrary: Substitution "{{substitutionId}}" for exercise "{{exerciseId}}" in session "{{sessionId}}" doesn't exist in the Library.
import.unrecognizedSchemaError: This file doesn't match the expected program format.

schema.dateFormat: Expected a date in yyyy-mm-dd format.
schema.rangeOrder: The top of the range must be at least the bottom.
schema.ladderAscending: Ladder weights must climb or hold, rung to rung — never drop.
schema.ladderSetsMismatch: A ladder's set count must match the number of rungs in its setPlan.
schema.sessionNeedsExercise: A session needs at least one exercise.
schema.activityNeedsItem: An activity needs at least one item.
schema.weekdayKeyRange: Weekday keys must be 1-7 (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday).
schema.endDateOrder: endDate must be on or after startDate.
schema.pinnedNeedsWeekdaySessions: Weekday-pinned scheduling needs at least one weekdaySessions entry.

zod.invalidUnion: This doesn't match any allowed shape.
zod.invalidElement: An entry in this list isn't valid.

import.missingFrontMatter: Missing front matter — expected a "---" block at the top of the file.
import.noSessionsFound: No sessions found — expected at least one "## Session: <id>" section.
import.sessionMissingColumn: Session "{{sectionId}}" table is missing the "{{column}}" column.
import.invalidRange: Session "{{sectionId}}": row for "{{exerciseId}}" has an invalid Range "{{value}}" — expected "min-max".
import.invalidWeights: Session "{{sectionId}}": row for "{{exerciseId}}" has invalid Weights "{{value}}" — expected "start/max/step" with "-" for null.
import.invalidLadder: Session "{{sectionId}}": row for "{{exerciseId}}" has an invalid Ladder "{{value}}" — expected weight×reps rungs separated by "/", e.g. "8x12 / 10x10 / 12x8".
import.ladderRowHasRange: Session "{{sectionId}}": row for "{{exerciseId}}" has both a Ladder and a Range — leave Range as "-" for a ladder row.
import.nonNumericField: Session "{{sectionId}}": row for "{{exerciseId}}" has a non-numeric Sets or Rest value.
import.unrecognizedWeekdayHeading: Activity heading "{{weekdayName}}" isn't a recognized weekday name (Monday … Sunday).
import.activityMissingItems: Activity "{{weekdayName}}" has no items — expected at least one "- " bullet line.
